name: Auto Ontology
cost: Free (Apache 2.0). It needs an NVIDIA API key; prices are not stated in the README
works_with: Any MCP client, plus a CLI, a REST API and a web UI
short: NVIDIA's library that builds a checked map of what your database tables mean, so an AI agent answers data questions with SQL you can verify.
what: Auto Ontology reads your database metadata and builds an ontology: business terms, reviewed SQL expressions and how tables join. People certify that draft. Then an agent answers questions in plain English, and every answer comes back with its SQL and the steps behind it. It connects to ten engines, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, Databricks, DuckDB and SQLite.
who: Data and platform teams who want agents to answer analytics questions they can check. It runs as a full stack with Docker, Postgres and model endpoints, so skip it if you just want a quick chat with a spreadsheet.
needs: An NVIDIA API key (`nvapi-...`) from build.nvidia.com, or your own OpenAI-compatible model endpoints

steps.title: Clone it and create .env
steps.text: In `.env`, set `DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY`, `AUTH_SECRET`, `APP_URL`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `CONNECTION_STRINGS`, `AUTO_ONTOLOGY_ADMIN_PASSWORD` and `PGADMIN_PASSWORD`. Replace every default password.

steps.title: Start Postgres and load the sample database
steps.text: The quickstart uses Wide World Importers, Microsoft's sample sales database. Use the Postgres password you set.
steps.code:
docker compose up -d --wait postgres
git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/auto-ontology-eval.git ../auto-ontology-eval
(cd ../auto-ontology-eval && uv sync && cp .env.example .env && \
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD='<the same password>' \
  uv run python scripts/seed/seed_wwi.py --database-name wideworldimporters --drop)

steps.title: Start the rest of the stack
Turn on semantic compilation
steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000, sign in with the admin email and password from `.env`, and turn on Settings, Semantic Compilation. Wait until it says Semantic compilation is ready.

steps.title: Optional: connect your agent over MCP
steps.text: The MCP server gives any MCP client read-only tools over the ontology, and each user signs in.

try.label: From the README
try.where: Chat in the Auto Ontology web UI
try.text: Ask: What was revenue for the USB food flash drive - sushi roll in Pennsylvania in June 2015? The answer should come back with its SQL and the steps that produced it.

watch: Compose publishes Postgres, pgAdmin and the web app on your machine, so replace every default password before you start it.
Keep ports 3001 and 3002 on a private network. The backend trusts the user ID the frontend forwards, and the ingestion service has no authentication of its own.
If you set `KUMO_RFM_API_KEY`, the agent uploads your connected tables to the hosted KumoRFM service for predictive questions. Check what that sends first.
The project is not accepting outside contributions.
